text: PM-AJAY stands for PM-AJAY (Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana). Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE). Target: Scheduled Caste (SC) families below poverty line. Income ceiling: Rs 250,000 per year. PM-AJAY consolidates three legacy SC welfare schemes (SPADP, PMSSI, PMKVY-SC) into a single umbrella for skill development, asset subsidy, and credit linkage for SC beneficiaries.

PM-AJAY Component: Skill Training via GIA (Grant-in-Aid). Funding: 100% Government Funded (zero cost to beneficiary). Includes: Free training at approved skill centers, Travel stipend, Free toolkits on graduation, Placement assistance. Duration Range: 3 months to 12 months depending on trade. Certification: NSQF Level 2 to Level 4 certificates recognized by NCVET.

PM-AJAY Component: Asset/Tool Subsidy for Self-Employment. Max Subsidy Inr: 50000. Max Subsidy Percent: 50. Description: Up to ₹50,000 or 50% of asset cost (whichever is less) for purchasing productive assets like sewing machines, e-rickshaws, dairy equipment, or agri-tools.. Eligible Assets: Sewing machine, E-rickshaw (WOW scheme), Dairy equipment, Poultry shed material, Mushroom spawn kits, Agri-tools, Micro-manufacturing machinery.
PM-AJAY Component: credit_linkages.
Credit Scheme: NSFDC Micro Finance Scheme. Max loan: Rs 140000. Interest rate: 6.5%. For: Small income-generating activities and working capital.
Credit Scheme: NSFDC Udyam Nidhi Scheme. Max loan: Rs 500000. Interest rate: 8.0%. For: Entrepreneurship and micro-enterprise setup.
Credit Scheme: MUDRA Shishu Loan. Max loan: Rs 50000. Interest rate: varies by bank%. For: Very small business startups.
Credit Scheme: MUDRA Kishore Loan. Max loan: Rs 500000. Interest rate: varies by bank%. For: Established micro-business expansion.

PM-AJAY Priority Model: Self-Employment and Enterprise Development. Trades: Mushroom Cultivation, Poultry Farming, Piggery, Pisciculture (Fish Farming), Goat Farming, Dairy. Income: ₹8,000 to ₹25,000 per month.

PM-AJAY Priority Model: Women on Wheels. Trades: . Income: ₹12,000 to ₹18,000 per month. SC women drive e-rickshaws funded by asset subsidy and NSFDC loan. Earn as delivery partner or passenger transport.
PM-AJAY Priority Model: Rural Logistics and Agri-Supply Chain. Trades: Warehousing Operator, Cold Chain Assistant, Agri-Transport Driver. Income: ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 per month.
PM-AJAY Priority Model: Micro-Manufacturing. Trades: Incense Stick Making, Candle Making, Bamboo Craft, Leather Goods, Handloom Weaving. Income: ₹7,000 to ₹15,000 per month.

To apply for PM-AJAY: visit DRDA or Block Development Office. Online: Apply at https://socialjustice.gov.in or via CSC (Common Service Centre) in your village. Documents: Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate (SC), Income Certificate (family income below ₹2,50,000), Bank account passbook, Passport-size photograph.
